versions.changelog: Hotfix: /analytics page crash + MOST CALLED card overflow. No skill-side changes; this version-bump just keeps the OpenClaw skill in lockstep with the SkillNote backend release.
Sidebar IA: Analytics + Marketplace moved into WORKSPACE; Connect group renamed to INTEGRATIONS. PWA maskable icon fixed (was bleeding teal in dock + home-screen).

0.5.2 — production-readiness sweep. SkillNote app: first-bite UX hardening, Connect page revamp, /health endpoint enrichment, universal error envelope, PWA chrome de-tealed. OpenClaw skill itself: no behavior changes; version aligned with app.

Install instructions updated to use 'npx skillnote start' (the new SkillNote CLI on npm) instead of 'git clone + ./install.sh'. SKILL.md text-only change; sync.sh, log-watcher.py, and API endpoints unchanged from v0.4.1. Aligns the skill's published version with the SkillNote CLI version (skillnote@0.5.1 on npm).

Scan-mitigation refactor for clawhub moderation flags. Removed install-backend.sh from bundle (agent now asks user to run git clone manually). log-watcher.py no longer writes a PID file (single-instance via pgrep instead). sync.sh writes ~/.openclaw/skillnote-agents.md sidecar instead of mutating ~/.openclaw/workspace/AGENTS.md (user adds @include line once with explicit consent). Added SECURITY.md to the bundle. Functional behavior preserved end-to-end. Display name bumped to brand CamelCase. Appeal context: github.com/openclaw/clawhub/issues/2135

Initial public release. Multi-agent attribution from session path, four analytics-integrity bug fixes, AGENTS.md graft hardening, version unification with the SkillNote app at 0.4.0, daily self-update check, install-backend.sh auto-bootstrap when localhost:8082 is unreachable.
